subject: history
attribution: Practice items adapted from Virginia Department of Education released SOL tests.

questions.stem: Which group established the town of Werowocomoco?

How do we know what life was like for Jamestown settlers? Historians study artifacts such as metal tools left behind by settlers to learn how those items were used. People studying the past best learn about artifacts like these by —
Which of these happened last?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Settlers learned survival skills from Powhatan and other native peoples.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Native peoples saw the settlers as invaders taking their land.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Settlers communicated with the native peoples through Pocahontas.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Native peoples taught the settlers to plant corn and other crops.

questions.stem: What is the best example of a cultural landscape (a human-made feature of the land)?
The arrival of European settlers changed the lives of American Indians by forcing them to —
The area of West Virginia became a state because —

choices.label: D
choices.text: John Brown caused a slave revolt

questions.stem: Author of the Virginia Statute for Religious Freedom Served as Governor during the Revolutionary War Served in the Continental Congress Which Virginian is responsible for these contributions?
Which group’s traditional homeland was located in the Coastal Plain (Tidewater) region of Virginia?
Edmund: “I think we should stay loyal to the king.” Joshua: “I think we should form our own nation.” Which statement about these two Virginians is probably true?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Only one led soldiers in the colonies.

choices.label: B
choices.text: They took opposite sides in the American Revolution.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Only one paid taxes in the colonies.

choices.label: D
choices.text: They had different opinions about African-American slavery.

questions.stem: A public meeting is advertised as supporting anti-slavery, with signs showing opposition to slavery and support for ending enslavement. Which group would most likely have supported this type of meeting?
During the Civil War, the ironclad ships Merrimack and Monitor fought a naval battle that ended without a clear winner. Which newspaper headline best describes the result of the battle?
During the Civil War, which group provided labor for the Confederate states?
Which Virginia governor is known for the “Pay As You Go” road improvement policy?

The Appalachian Mountain system includes several regions. One of these regions is the Valley and Ridge region, which lies west of the Blue Ridge Mountains and is part of the Appalachian system. Which region completes this description?
A settler in Richmond who wanted to return to Europe would travel on which river to reach the Chesapeake Bay and the Atlantic Ocean?
Which body of water separates the Eastern Shore of Virginia from the Virginia mainland?

Mari lives in Virginia near the North Carolina border. She is writing a history report on the native peoples who lived near her home and spoke an Iroquoian language. Which American Indians will be described in Mari’s report?
A diagram shows that rivers provided: transportation routes pathways for exploration access to food resources The best title for this diagram is —

choices.label: A
choices.text: Why American Indians Lived in Virginia

choices.label: B
choices.text: The Reasons to Defend Jamestown From Spain

choices.label: D
choices.text: The Importance of Rivers to the Virginia Settlement

questions.stem: The first settlers founded Jamestown on —
The Burning of Jamestown occurred during Bacon’s Rebellion in 1676. What was the result of this event?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Colonists leave the Chesapeake Bay area

choices.label: C
choices.text: Colonists join the local American Indian tribe

questions.stem: The charters of the Virginia Company of London gave —
Cause: The colonists felt they ____________________. Effect: The colonists decided to fight for independence. Which phrase best completes this cause-and-effect relationship?

choices.label: A
choices.text: had the right to own slaves

choices.label: C
choices.text: had the right to govern themselves

questions.stem: Legal Authority in the Colonies British Ideas: Parliament held lawmaking power Colonists’ Ideas: Lawmaking power should be held by __________ Which group completes this comparison?
After Reconstruction, the freedoms given to African Americans were —

choices.label: A
choices.text: taken away by Jim Crow laws

choices.label: C
choices.text: increased by the Bill of Rights

questions.stem: “VOTE for John Montgomery Virginia House of Delegates” If John Montgomery wins this election, his job will be to —

choices.label: B
choices.text: decide which people go to court

questions.stem: As a result of the Civil Rights Movement, laws were passed that —

choices.label: A
choices.text: gave immigrants the right to work

choices.label: C
choices.text: gave women the right to vote

Why was the Freedmen’s Bureau created?
Which industry has contributed most to migration within modern Virginia?
